faq.q: What do the reading presets actually change?
faq.a: Each preset sets three controls at once: speed, words per chunk, and font size. Beginner is 180 WPM with 1 word and large 52px text; Normal is 250 WPM; Fast is 400 WPM with 2-word chunks; Skim is 650 WPM with 3 words; Sprint is 900 WPM with 5 words. You can also set any value manually with the WPM slider (100–1000).

faq.q: How does 'Pause on punctuation' change the timing?
faq.a: When enabled, the tool lengthens the pause based on the last character of the chunk. Words ending in a period, exclamation mark, or question mark get double the normal delay, while words ending in a comma, semicolon, or colon get 1.3x. This mimics natural reading pauses at sentence and clause boundaries, and it works in both RSVP and Highlight modes.

faq.q: What file types can I import, and are there size limits?
faq.a: You can drop or upload .txt and .md files, with a 5MB cap. The tool also checks the content: if it finds null bytes or more than three Unicode replacement characters, it rejects the file as binary renamed to .txt. Empty files are refused too. You can alternatively paste text or pick one of five built-in practice passages.

faq.q: What does the 'Split into session ZIP' button produce?
faq.a: It splits your text into roughly 10-minute reading sessions based on your current WPM (words-per-chunk = WPM x 10), then bundles them as numbered part-01.txt files plus a README inside a ZIP using JSZip. If the whole text is under one session it declines and tells you there's nothing to split. The ZIP is generated in your browser.
